paths.blurb: Ten readings that walk the gospel from the problem to the empty tomb, each opened in context, ending at the doctrine that ties them together.

steps.note: The fall, and the first promise of a deliverer.

steps.label: Isaiah 53, the suffering servant

steps.note: The great confession, and the road to the cross.

steps.note: Saved by grace, not by works, so no one can boast.

paths.title: Read the whole story

steps.note: The promise of a king whose throne lasts forever.

steps.note: A law written on the heart, promised in exile.

steps.label: The church and the Spirit

paths.title: For the honest skeptic
paths.audience: Not a believer, willing to look
paths.blurb: No altar call at the end of this. Eight stops through the hardest objections, stated at full strength before any answer, so you can weigh the claims for yourself.

paths.title: When your faith is shaking
paths.audience: Believers in the middle of doubt

steps.note: Start here. The answer is no, and the Bible's own people prove it.

steps.label: Is it okay to be angry at God?
steps.note: The psalms argue with God to his face. So can you.

steps.label: Is deconstruction okay?

steps.label: Believing without the feelings

steps.label: Not every question carries the same weight
steps.note: Triage. Some of what shook you may never have been load-bearing.

steps.label: What faith actually is
steps.note: Not a leap in the dark. Trust, with its eyes open, in a person.
